title: DIP Switch
text: Connect signals attached to DIP switches on hardware board, 1 input, 1 output, {IO logic} sets IO logic indicator; {Hardware board} sets the view selected hardware, {View DIP switches location} sets the view DIP switches, {Specify DIP switches via} sets the dIP switch source, {Number of DIP switches} sets the dIP switch selection, {DS n} sets the selected DIP switches and {Sample time} sets the system sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Hardware board
params.values: View selected hardware None (default) | Supported Xilinx ® or Intel ® boards | Custom boards

params.name: IO logic
params.values: IO logic indicator None (default) | Active High | Active Low

params.name: Number of DIP switches
params.values: DIP switch selection 1 (default) | list of integers in the range [1, n]
